[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of warm-up exercises including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Light Cardio: Jogging or jumping jacks.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Leg Swings: Swinging legs forward and backward.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Arm Circles: Making circles with arms.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Shoulder Rolls: Rolling shoulders forward and backward.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Neck Stretches: Tilting head to the side.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Wrist Extensions: Lifting and lowering hands.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Leg Raises: Raising one leg at a time.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Tennis-Specific Drills: Light forehand and backhand swings.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Dynamic Stretching: High knees, butt kicks, or side shuffles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended a 10-15 minute warm-up before starting the game.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Clean the racket head with a soft, dry cloth.
